diseases.name: Healthy
symptoms: No visible signs of disease or pest damage
prevention: Provide adequate water, sunlight, and nutrients

diseases.name: Red rust
symptoms: Reddish spots or rust-colored pustules on leaves
causes: Fungal infection due to Puccinia species

diseases.name: Leaf miner
symptoms: Visible tunnels or trails on leaves made by larvae
causes: Insect infestation by larvae of various fly species
treatments: Use insecticidal soap or neem oil

diseases.name: Gumosis
prevention: Properly prune and maintain tree health

diseases.name: Anthracnose
symptoms: Dark, sunken lesions on leaves or fruits
causes: Fungal infection, often thrives in damp conditions
prevention: Remove and destroy infected plant material
